I replied to Ilse in her direct message. She should keep **Tuesday, 10 November at 12:45** free for the Lantern call.

- **Where the time comes from:** On 14 October, Ilse told me in this same direct message that her Lantern rollout call with the Tamsin Cold Chain team is every Tuesday at 12:45. That's the only record I found of it.
- **Not on her calendar:** Her calendar has no events next week (9–13 November). My reply says I'm going by what she told me and asks her to say if the time has changed.

I only used what Ilse can see herself: her own direct message with me and her own calendar. I didn't add anything to her calendar.
